name: Volatile Reagents

source.title: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powder Keg

disable: Three DC 20 Acrobatics check or DC 20 Crafting check checks to sort and separate the bottles of volatile ingredients into groups
reset: The lab contains enough ingredients for this hazard to last 1 minute before all materials are expended. Alternatively, the hazard resets once Slick shrinks to regular size.
routine: (1 action) A random 10-foot square in Gattlebee's laboratory explodes, dealing 2d6 damage to creatures and objects in the area (DC 18 basic Reflex save). The damage type is randomly determined each round: acid, cold, electricity, fire, slashing, or sonic.

items.name: Explosive Catalyst
items.text:
Trigger Slick drinks Gattlebee's growth serum

---

Effect The giant lizard bumps into lab tables and workbenches, causing dangerous ingredients to intermix and detonate. The hazard rolls initiative.

text: Potion bottles, alembics, and potent ingredients violently explode when jostled and accidentally combined.
